summary.experiment: Original16consumed scenes/2064states,8/16cells per metre and four shapes including32cubed/rectangles, fixed1/60s outputs with K=4advancing4/60s. A training-only native-qualified midpoint backtrace supplies detached displacement labels from the actual entering predicted state; target error is scaled by alpha squared. Labels are consumed after prediction and are absent from the inference module. All original receipts/recipes/inputs/outputs, nested assets, tensors and work counters verify.
summary.lesson: The controlled K1 diagnostic locates the fixed-viscosity series' shared 32-cubed pressure limit mainly in its CNN fallback. Other pressure-map and request errors remain. Freezing accurate local coefficients does not ensure a comparably accurate full generator; compare the complete pressure, velocities and tracer with the F64 composition before promoting a design.
summary.method: A100,456-parameter recurrent full-state generator for K=4:6,600trainable coefficients and93,856frozen spatial-pressure/flux/point/viscosity coefficients. One width12fluid encoder is shared across a pass. Each output updates retained features, predicts four carrier displacements from a fused frozen-point/trainable-local projection with an alpha-squared curvature correction, and reconstructs velocity/tracer through fixed convex trilinear gathers. Frozen learned viscosity then acts on forced velocity, followed by learned flux, the inherited pressure map and tied momentum. Koutputs still require Kpressure/flux/momentum readouts and Ktransport reconstructions; there is no cheap endpoint-only pressure shortcut.
summary.outcome: Matched GPU benchmark on 64 retained cases: worst pressure, combined velocity and tracer relative L2 are 0.000523745, 0.000291008 and 1.60219e-05. Median time is 16.03146 ms per K4 block (4.00786 ms per physical output); the worst case median is 10.59364 ms/output. The retained F64 N1 composition has better worst pressure error and 31.09 times lower matched median GPU time. These are consumed fitting scenes, not an independent holdout or long rollout.

summary.experiment: CUDA full-batch LBFGS, 24 maximum iterations and 60 maximum closures. Cache the same teacher-derived inputs/targets on GPU; select the best complete closure including the exact warm start. Recorded internal iteration counters are not minibatch update counts. Objective is per-head output-RMS-normalized correction MSE; physical metrics are diagnostics, not the selection objective. All148 training scenes are counted, but only29N8 scenes provide parameter-dependent gradients:9 starts×3 groups=783 local samples. The119N1 scenes contribute1,071 fixed control windows with zero parameter derivative. Active grids span eight shapes through64³, at8/10/16/25/50/100cells per metre; the complete fixed/control population includes19shapes through128³.
summary.lesson: Optimization improvements on local teacher-state corrections do not establish accurate own-history reduced integration. The N8 runner advances groups2/2/3/1 with three correction calls per physical1/60s output; K1–K4 outputs still advance sequentially. It does not predict a distant endpoint with cheap temporal intermediate frames. N1 bypasses this correction and preserves the original branch. Keep effective gradient scenes, fixed controls, loss choice, trained checkpoint and complete execution variant separate.
summary.method: A10,876-parameter float32 CUDA correction CNN:42 cell-lattice input channels, two width8 clamped3×3×3 convolutions with SiLU, three staggered transposed-convolution velocity heads and one tracer head. Output heads initialize to zero. The quiescence gate uses current/coarse-change/known-force channels. Pressure correction is supplied through the frozen learned coupled projection; this subnet does not directly emit pressure. Inputs include spacing100h, group duration480dt, group width and ordered known forces; future fields are labels only.
summary.outcome: Selected training objective 0.74515826956031694; selected closure 51 after 24 recorded LBFGS iterations / 51 closure evaluations. Its separately recorded physical objective is 6.3435674501696377e-05; the direct-delta objective cannot be compared numerically with S1/S3 physical objectives. The retained complete-generator replay passes all 920 N1 outputs and fails 1151 of 1200 N8 outputs at the diagnostic1e-5 gate. These are original consumed cases, not independent validation or qualified new latency.
summary.purpose: Continue the exact selected S3 weights but directly supervise the four missing correction heads, while tracking the coupled physical objective separately.

summary.experiment: 10,000 whole-network Adam updates, batch 1, initial learning rate 0.001, schedule [], seed 20261015, PCG64 sample seed 2026102501 and gradient clipping at norm 1.0. Training uses just native frame 15 from one 16x16x16 scene at 8 cells/metre and a 1/60 s physical timestep. The 64 validation scenes supply 128 pressure frames at 8/16 cells per metre, with small rectangular grids. The equal-weight objective combines normalized squared pressure-field and FV equation errors. Preprocessing RMS scales are fitted on the one training frame; reserved-test bindings remain separate. The final configured update is selected; no optimizer-resume state is saved.
summary.lesson: The higher constant rate improves common worst pressure error versus C07, while captured average validation loss is higher. Keep average training objectives and worst field-error comparisons separate.
summary.method: The same seven-channel multiscale 3D pressure-correction CNN as C07: 371,729 F32 parameters in 38 tensors, encoder widths 8/16/24/32, bottleneck 48, decoder widths 32/24/16/8, SiLU and a linear pressure head. Residual, previous pressure, metre-valued XYZ coordinates, fluid density and physical timestep are inputs. The cell-zero-gauged correction is added to previous pressure using F64 reconstruction and FV arithmetic. One call proposes pressure; it does not advance a simulation. Affine-free four-group GroupNorm remains in each convolutional block.
summary.outcome: The last sampled training loss is 8.7058237643506163e-07; captured validation objective 17.70540289055894 initially and 0.011801414615625866 finally. On the common 128 native pressure requests, worst mean-free pressure relative L2 is 0.20990593032860855 and equation relative L2 is 0.27333002869364859. These common errors differ from the training objective. This review adds no timing measurement or drift result.
summary.purpose: Test a constant 0.001 learning rate on the same single-frame fitting control.

summary.experiment: Both original fits use the same16train-only scenes/2064states,8/16cells per metre, four shapes including32cubed/rectangles, fixed1/60s outputs, and2/60s per block. Original source/typed recipe/input/output closures, all initial/final tensors, exact seeded initialization and PCG64sample stream verify. Both train10,000CUDAupdates with identical learning-rate schedule and2000one-block then8000two-own-history-block curriculum,18,000encoder calls. Both replace prior log1p-scaled pressure/equation/field/physical terms with MSE terms; between these two arms only velocity/tracer denominators differ. Pressure/equation and divergence/mass/energy/bounds coefficients remain common to the pair.
summary.lesson: Sharing an encoder, endpoint or retained features does not by itself establish a useful accuracy/speed tradeoff. This fit remains worse than the matched F64 composition in both worst pressure error and median GPU time. Account for every intermediate output and reconstruction cost; K outputs advance K full 1/60-second intervals.
summary.method: A163,068-parameter F32width12K2endpoint-conditioned generator with one shared spatial/global encoder, fresh predicted endpoint and joint intermediate decoder. It retains the audited fixed train-only force/increment scaling, excludes previous pressure, and predicts all five fields without a numerical pressure solver. Its model implementation, initial tensors and deployed feedback match the earlier scaled endpoint; only the fitted objective changes. Velocity/tracer use mean squared full prediction error divided by fixed aggregate training increment RMS squared at each horizon. The numerator remains predicted full state minus target full state, including accumulated state error; it does not replace reference history or supervise only a detached local delta.
summary.outcome: Matched GPU benchmark on 64 retained cases: worst pressure, combined velocity and tracer relative L2 are 0.579857, 0.508242 and 0.0059041. Median time is 4.78939 ms per K2 block (2.39469 ms per physical output); the worst case median is 2.88880 ms/output. The retained F64 N1 composition has better worst pressure error and 13.36 times lower matched median GPU time. These are consumed fitting scenes, not an independent holdout or long rollout.
summary.purpose: Use a matched MSE pair to isolate whether supervising velocity/tracer in typical-step units improves predictive increments when full-state field magnitude can hide small changes. A separate full-state MSE arm controls the removal of the earlier logarithmic robust objective.

summary.experiment: 10,000CUDA Adam updates, batch1, model seed2026101921/sample seed2026101922. Rate0.001 drops to0.0003 at6001 and0.0001 at9001. Sixteen train-only scenes provide129consecutive states each: eight at8cells/metre and eight at16, with16cubed,9x11x11,15x6x8 and32cubed domains, two seeds per grid/density. Each scene spans128/60seconds of retained native simulation. Updates1–2000supervise one K-output block; later updates add a second block from the first block own reconstructed endpoint, yielding18,000network calls and36,000predicted states during fitting. Source state indices are sampled0..120. The loss averages field/equation log-relative-square terms plus divergence, mass, energy and tracer-bound penalties. Known forcing varies in space/time, but its integration and features are fixed at1/60s; no independent dt channel is present. Fitting pressure labels are quantized toF32, with recorded worst conversion relative L2 6.225179570786273e-8; original native evaluation fields remain separate.
summary.lesson: This retained design has higher worst pressure error and median GPU time than the matched F64 composition. Its method and fitting purpose remain recorded above; these measurements compare distinct designs and do not show that one checkpoint deteriorated. Judge complete physical outputs rather than a pressure-only component or a training-loss value.
summary.method: A 18,132-parameter F32 joint full-state generator for K=2. A shared width4 encoder consumes the padded current five-field state, normalized coordinates, log grid counts/spacing and current known force. One3x3x3 convolution plus1x1 layers produce fine/coarse shared features; inexpensive joint1x1heads also receive all K prescribed force increments. A pooled32hidden-unit branch predicts63nonconstant cosine pressure coefficients per horizon. It emits pressure, three staggered velocities and tracer jointly; pressure is cell-zero gauged, velocity walls are masked, and physical fields are cropped/scaled. Pressure is computed in F32 then cast/gauged in F64 on unpacking; this is not F64 internal pressure prediction. No pressure solver or sequential physical advance is called inside this network.
summary.outcome: Matched GPU benchmark on 64 retained cases: worst pressure, combined velocity and tracer relative L2 are 1.039, 0.833693 and 0.0172616. Median time is 3.73962 ms per K2 block (1.86981 ms per physical output); the worst case median is 2.09992 ms/output. The retained F64 N1 composition has better worst pressure error and 10.43 times lower matched median GPU time. These are consumed fitting scenes, not an independent holdout or long rollout.
summary.purpose: Test amortizing one current-state encoding over 2 simultaneous physical outputs at1/60s spacing, compared with the other protocol2 K1/2/3/4 joint-head generators.
